desc: Cinnamon Cheerios Protein treats you and your family to an O-so-delicious taste with 8g of protein per serving. This sweetened oat and pea protein cereal delivers satisfying cinnamon flavor in every bowl. Each serving of this gluten free cereal contains 12g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), with no artificial colors or flavors. Keep a Large Size box of this protein cereal made with whole grain in your pantry for part of a quick breakfast. Try some with or without cold milk as a snack in the morning or after school. Sprinkle some over Greek yogurt as a crispy addition to breakfast on the go. However you enjoy Cheerios Protein, General Mills cereals spread goodness from tots to grown-ups.
features:
CHEERIOS PROTEIN CEREAL: You'll get 8g of protein in each serving of this sweetened oat and pea protein cereal

DELICIOUS CINNAMON TASTE: Every spoonful treats your taste buds to the delicious taste of cinnamon; Ideal as part of breakfast, an anytime snack, or a late night bite

WHOLE GRAIN: Provides 12g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily), with no artificial colors or flavors

GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: A gluten free cereal that the whole family can enjoy; Also try it as an ingredient in gluten free snack recipes such as crispy cereal bars or a protein snack mix

CONTAINS: One 11.2 oz Large Size box of Cinnamon Cheerios Protein Cereal
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Pea Protein, Brown Sugar Syrup, Corn Starch, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Cinnamon, Tripotassium Phosphate, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
